_comment: WC-TW-6c LHCI ratchet: medians of 5 Lighthouse runs per region on the CI production build. While a median is over its absolute error threshold the gate asserts median <= baseline x (1 + tolerance) and the absolute threshold is a warning; lower these in every reduction PR.

regions._comment: WC-TW-6c-12 per-region ratchet: lcp_ms and tbt_ms are each region's own median over the same 6 runs (the region collects run on the same runner as gh-runner, so TBT is CPU-only and tracks the runner).

rule: WC-TW-6c-12. Baseline = median over >= 5 main runs at one SHA of each run's per-region median. Gate = baseline x (1 + tolerance): LCP 10% (same-code worst run was <= 1.02x its median), TBT 100% (same-code worst run 1.35-1.61x its median, because GH runners come in two CPU classes: benchmarkIndex ~2400 gives TBT 1100-1620 ms, ~3000-4200 gives 450-850 ms). Lighthouse runs 5 per region (was 3) so the cold first run on a fresh next start (TBT 0.85-10.2 s) never decides the median. Every collected run passes the new gates; bundle regressions stay hard-gated by perf/js-baseline.json (5 KB tolerance). Lower these baselines in every reduction PR.
